ignoreValues.reason: Email HTML template (api/book.ts) can't use the web app's self-hosted fonts - email clients need a system-font fallback stack. Not a DESIGN.md violation, a different medium's constraint.

Remaining hits are two tiny interaction-triggered nudges (explorer/menu tab active-state indent, ~0.4rem, click-triggered not scroll) on small inline elements; the carousel-dot width transition in this same file was fixed to transform:scaleX. Fixing the other two needs a markup wrapper to move the nudge to transform - cost outweighs the negligible perf benefit at this element size/frequency.
